display.purpose: Displaying main headings and title names.

headline.purpose: Titles for lists, grids, and sections.

components.name: Primary Pill Button
components.description: Primary action button used for confirmations and main actions.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #7a5487; color: #ffffff; border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: opacity 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { opacity: 0.9; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Secondary button for backing out of actions or secondary selections.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { background: #e8dced; color: #7a5487; border: none; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 200ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { filter: brightness(0.95); }

components.name: White Dashboard Card
components.description: Standard card container carrying clean summaries.
components.css: .ds-card-white { background: #ffffff; border: 1px solid rgba(26, 26, 46, 0.06); border-radius: 12px; padding: 22px 28px; font-family: 'DM Sans', sans-serif; color: #1a1a2e; } .ds-card-white h3 { font-family: 'Geist', sans-serif; color: #1a1a2e; font-size: 18px; margin-bottom: 4px; font-weight: 600; }

narrative.northStar: Clean SaaS workspace with premium purple highlights
narrative.overview: Zora Console Light utilizes a clean, high-contrast interface designed to convey professional utility and visual clarity. The app shell is anchored on a light background (#f5f5f7), framing pure white card surfaces (#ffffff) that hold user workflows. Accents of rich purple (#7a5487) define primary controls, interactive highlights, and status signifiers.
keyCharacteristics: Clean light-mode palette using Soft White cards over a light gray shell.
Modern typography featuring crisp geometric headings (Geist/DM Sans).
Semantic color coding for warnings, positive completion, and alerts.
Tactile card layouts with subtle spacing and soft borders.

rules.name: The White-on-Purple Rule
rules.body: Any text overlaying a Primary Purple background must be pure white (#ffffff) or near-white to maintain an accessible contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1.

rules.name: The Meta Tracking Rule
rules.body: All meta labels must be rendered in uppercase with precise tracking (0.06em or 0.08em) to guarantee scan-readability at small font sizes.

rules.name: The Flat-Border Rule
rules.body: Card borders must use a thin border of 1px solid rgba(26, 26, 46, 0.06) or rgba(122, 84, 135, 0.12) instead of drop shadows to preserve a clean, flat-layout feel.

dos: Do use Soft White (#ffffff) for content card backgrounds and Background (#f5f5f7) for the outer layout shell.
Do apply Primary Purple (#7a5487) to all primary CTAs, active highlights, and page titles.
Do format meta labels in uppercase with explicit character spacing.
donts: Don't use dark backgrounds or dark themes; the interface strictly employs the light SaaS console theme.
Don't use black text on a purple background; use pure white (#ffffff).
Don't use fluid text scaling on headings; stick to the fixed H1-H3 scale.
Don't apply heavy dark box shadows on card elements.
